A search on 2026-10-11 found an Uber Eats store page 'Cheba Hut Johnston Merle Hay' (summary: 4.9 rating, 110+ reviews), but the page itself returned 403 and could not be checked. No closure reports found. On 2026-10-11 the location page chebahut.com/locations/johnston-merlehay/ returned HTTP 429 (Vercel security checkpoint) to direct fetches and redirected to the chebahut.com homepage in a browser, so the brand site did not confirm the shop is current. Likely open, but unverified from a first-party source today.
rows.notes: National chain; the website field correctly points at the Johnston location page, but on 2026-10-11 that URL redirected to the chebahut.com homepage in a browser. Re-check it, because a removed location page can mean a closed shop. chebahut.com sits behind a Vercel bot checkpoint (HTTP 429), so neither the location page nor the menu could be read by direct fetch, and no location-specific menu or prices were captured.
